message.reasoning:
I'm in jail so I have shelter. GPT just paid me $550 in rent after landing on Vermont, but now he's down to $1 cash and sold off his hotels to cover it. I control three light-blue properties—Oriental, Vermont, and Connecticut—so he's essentially bankrupt if he lands on any of them. The main threat to me is his remaining green properties with four houses each on Pacific, North Carolina, and Pennsylvania.

Looking at the rent costs: Pacific and North Carolina each charge $1100 with four houses, and Pennsylvania charges $1275. I have $1451, so I can survive landing on any of them now. Since GPT is at $1 and desperate, staying in jail is still the best move—I collect rent whenever he lands on my properties while he's forced to keep moving. I'll roll for doubles to stay in jail for free rather than paying $50 to leave.
